In ICU sepsis models, observation frequency became a confounder; in autonomous robotics, a 50-millisecond timestamp jitter causes a 1.4-meter bounding box dislocation at highway speeds.

solo.contentHtml:
◆
The Telemetry Profile: The NASDAQ TotalView-ITCH feed broadcasts every order book update, execution, and cancellation at rates exceeding $1.5\text{ Million events per second}$.
▸
The Failure of Batching: Traditional batching architectures buffering 1-second chunks created $1,000\text{ ms}$ blind spots, causing automated market-making algorithms to execute on stale order book prices and suffer catastrophic adverse selection.
⚡
The Streaming Resolution: Market infrastructures transitioned to Hardware-Accelerated UDP Multicast & Apache Kafka/Aeron streams. Ingestion pipelines process tick updates with deterministic sub-50 microsecond p99 latencies, ensuring that training feature matrices maintain complete temporal fidelity ((Wang et al., 2015)).

The Telemetry Firehose: Tesla's global fleet of 5 million vehicles records 8 high-definition video cameras and ultrasonic radar pings continuously, generating over $40\text{ Gigabytes per vehicle per hour}$ ($200\text{ Petabytes/hour}$ fleet-wide).

The Bandwidth Wall: Uploading continuous raw video over LTE/5G is financially impossible.
⚡
The Edge Trigger Architecture: Tesla vehicles run lightweight Edge Neural Trigger Classifiers directly on the in-car FSD hardware. ◆
The Vulnerability: High-frequency smart electric meters sample power draw at $1\text{ Hz}$. Using Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) neural networks, adversaries can disaggregate appliance power draws from the composite signal, deducing when residents wake up, watch television, or leave their homes vacant.
